title: Escaping Local Minima Provably in Non-convex Matrix Sensing: A Deterministic Framework via Simulated Lifting
abstract: arXiv:2602.05887v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Low-rank matrix sensing is a fundamental yet challenging nonconvex problem whose optimization landscape typically contains numerous spurious local minima, making it difficult for gradient-based optimizers to converge to the global optimum. Recent work has shown that over-parameterization via tensor lifting can convert such local minima into strict saddle points, an insight that also partially explains why massive scaling can improve generalization and performance in modern machine learning. Motivated by this observation, we propose a Simulated Oracle Direction (SOD) escape mechanism that simulates the landscape and escape direction of the over-parametrized space, without resorting to actually lifting the problem, since that would be computationally intractable. In essence, we designed a mathematical framework to project over-parametrized escape directions onto the original parameter space to guarantee a strict decrease of objective v

translated_title: 在非凸矩阵感知中可证明地逃离局部极小值：一种通过模拟提升的确定性框架
translated_abstract: 低秩矩阵感知是一个基础但具有挑战性的非凸问题，其优化景观通常包含大量虚假的局部极小值，这使得基于梯度的优化器难以收敛到全局最优解。近期研究表明，通过张量提升的过参数化可以将这些局部极小值转化为严格鞍点，这一见解也部分解释了为什么大规模扩展能改善现代机器学习中的泛化性能和表现。受此观察启发，我们提出了一种模拟预言方向（SOD）逃逸机制，该机制模拟过参数化空间的景观和逃逸方向，而无需实际提升问题，因为那样在计算上不可行。本质上，我们设计了一个数学框架，将过参数化的逃逸方向投影到原始参数空间，以保证目标函数的严格下降。
tldr: 本文提出一种模拟提升的确定性框架，通过将过参数化逃逸方向投影回原始空间，可证明地逃离非凸矩阵感知中的局部极小值，而无需实际计算昂贵的提升过程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a deterministic framework via simulated lifting that provably escapes local minima in non-convex matrix sensing by projecting over-parameterized escape directions back to the original space, without the computational cost of actual lifting.
